description: This Java class 'PreviewRenderContext' implements the 'RenderContext' interface to provide a customized rendering context for Android layout previews, allowing configuration and file overrides.

classes.name: PreviewRenderContext
classes.description: A class implementing RenderContext to facilitate custom preview rendering with specific configuration and file context.

methods.name: PreviewRenderContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the preview context with a base render context, a custom configuration, and an XML file.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the custom configuration used for rendering.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Delegates setting a new configuration to the underlying render context.

methods.name: requestRender
methods.description: Delegates a render request to the underlying render context.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the usage type, specifically 'THUMBNAIL_PREVIEW'.

methods.name: getXmlFile
methods.description: Returns the XML file associated with this context.

methods.name: getVirtualFile
methods.description: Returns the virtual file associated with the XML file.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with the render context.

methods.name: hasAlphaChannel
methods.description: Checks if the rendering supports an alpha channel.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the UI component for rendering.

methods.name: getFullImageSize
methods.description: Returns the full size of the rendered image.

methods.name: getScaledImageSize
methods.description: Returns the scaled size of the rendered image.

methods.name: getClientArea
methods.description: Returns the client area rectangle.

methods.name: getPreviewManager
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a preview manager.

methods.name: setMaxSize
methods.description: Sets maximum size constraints for rendering.

methods.name: supportsPreviews
methods.description: Indicates if previews are supported.

methods.name: zoomFit
methods.description: Adjusts zoom to fit the view.

methods.name: updateLayout
methods.description: Updates the layout of the rendering.

methods.name: setDeviceFramesEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables device frames.

methods.name: getRenderedImage
methods.description: Returns the rendered image as a BufferedImage.

methods.name: getViewHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the hierarchy of the rendered view.
